label: Kinetic poster
instruction: Build a clear typographic hierarchy from the supplied headline, proof and supporting copy. Use fixed readable glyph sizes, staged position/opacity and a short reveal only for an explicitly mapped short proof. Portrait material can form a vertical stack; preserve full copy and a real reading hold. Do not imitate font scaling with width tracks.

provenance.adaptation: Own stable 2D slots and native y/opacity/reveal tracks at30fps. No spring/container/mask/caret, animated color or glyph scaling. Existing text is never split or rewritten; short proof role is explicit.
